feature.name: One-tap reorder, with word of mouth
feature.summary: Grocery customers repeat their last order in a few taps: check items, pick a slot, pay with the saved card.

funnel.name: Confirms payment with the saved card

hypotheses.text: At least 60% of customers who open the sheet place the order.
At least 25% of all active customers use it.
At least 10% of new customers use it.

levers.lever: Give users without saved_card a way through 'Confirms payment with the saved card'
Make the 'Home banner' entry point easier to find
Make the 'Sunday push notification' entry point easier to find
Give users without past_order a way through 'Opens the reorder sheet'
Make the 'Reorder button in order history' entry point easier to find
Cut the effort of 'Confirms payment with the saved card'
Make 'Confirms payment with the saved card' clearer
Make 'Replaces or removes out-of-stock items' clearer
Cut the effort of 'Replaces or removes out-of-stock items'
Cut the effort of 'Reviews the items and prices'
Cut the effort of 'Picks a delivery slot'
Make 'Reviews the items and prices' clearer
Halve the errors at 'Order is placed'
Halve the errors at 'Picks a delivery slot'

variants.name: Usual slot pre-selected
variants.note: The slot step shows the customer's usual slot already chosen.

variants.name: Add a card inline
variants.note: Customers without a saved card can add one without leaving the flow.

scenarios.name: Fewer customers have a saved card than we think
scenarios.note: The saved-card shares are guesses from the payments team, not a query.

scenarios.name: The home banner is noticed twice as often
scenarios.note: If the banner gets the top slot for launch week.

watchlist.name: Confirms payment with the saved card

instrumentation.name: Confirms payment with the saved card

lint.message: 'Opens the reorder sheet' needs past_order. About 21% of users lack it and have nowhere to go.
lint.fix: Add a fallback step (set it up, request it, or explain why not).

lint.message: 'Confirms payment with the saved card' needs saved_card. About 40% of users lack it and have nowhere to go.
lint.fix: Add a fallback step (set it up, request it, or explain why not).

lint.message: 'Confirms payment with the saved card' fires no analytics event: a drop here would be invisible after launch.
lint.fix: Add an event for this step.

lint.message: 'Order is placed' can fail (4%) but the model says nothing about what happens next.
lint.fix: Define on_error: can the user retry, or where do they land?

depends.change: Happy users talk twice as much
Each person who talks tells twice as many people
The feature reaches everyone in the first week
Unhappy users talk twice as much
Listeners accept any opinion, however far from their own
